# Chromium Dino assets

This directory vendors the offline Dino sprite sheets from Chromium:

- `100-offline-sprite.png`
- `200-offline-sprite.png`

Source:

- https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/components/neterror/resources/neterror.html
- https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/components/neterror/resources/images/default_100_percent/offline/100-offline-sprite.png
- https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/components/neterror/resources/images/default_200_percent/offline/200-offline-sprite.png

The sprite coordinate constants used by the web app are derived from:

- https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/components/neterror/resources/dino_game/offline_sprite_definitions.ts
- https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/components/neterror/resources/dino_game/trex.ts
- https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/components/neterror/resources/dino_game/distance_meter.ts

Chromium's BSD-style license is included as `LICENSE.chromium`.
